_readme: EDIT ME: point refresh_url at the API that mints fresh links for your host. Placeholders: {0e} = full original URL URL-encoded (use this in query strings), {0} = full original URL raw, {1}/{2}/{name} = capture groups from 'match'. 'url_field' is the dotted JSON path to the fresh link in the API response (e.g. 'url', 'data.url', 'result.0.link'). Test with:  idm refresh "<paste an expired URL>"  — or let a batch do it automatically.

link_providers._note: Generic provider: any https URL that carries a token in the query string. Narrow 'match' to your real domain (e.g. ^https://cdn\.myhost\.com/) once confirmed, and list more specific providers ABOVE this one — first match wins.
